subject.title: Feature: Support Telegram media groups (albums) in message tool

question: Should OpenClaw add native Telegram sendMediaGroup album support now, and should it extend the existing send/mediaUrls pipeline or introduce a separate send-media-group action?
rationale: This is a new user-visible Telegram action/delivery capability with API-shape and fallback semantics that need maintainer intent before an automated repair lane chooses a permanent interface.

options.title: Port into existing send pipeline
options.body: Extend current mediaUrls handling to batch eligible Telegram media into albums while falling back to existing sequential sends for non-groupable cases.

options.title: Accept a separate album action
options.body: Use a distinct send-media-group action if maintainers want albums to be explicit instead of automatic based on mediaUrls.

options.title: Defer album support
options.body: Keep current sequential multi-media delivery and close or freeze the draft implementation until stronger product demand appears.

recommendation.title: Port into existing send pipeline
recommendation.body: Extend current mediaUrls handling to batch eligible Telegram media into albums while falling back to existing sequential sends for non-groupable cases.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete already reviewed this exact cleanup path and is connected to recent Telegram action/media history.
